Name: EasyFish
Author: ArslanAR24
Description:
Make fishing in Stardew Valley exactly how you want it! [b]EasyFish[/b] is a highly customizable, all-in-one fishing mod that lets you automate the tedious parts, skip the minigames, or perfectly tailor the mechanics to your playstyle.
Whether you want to instantly catch every fish, hunt for specific species, or just stop reeling in trash, this mod has you covered!
✨ Key Features
[list]
[*][b]In-Game Configuration Menu:[/b] Press [b]J[/b] (default, customizable) to open a dedicated UI menu. Toggle all features on the fly without needing to edit config files manually![/*]
[*][b]Instant Fishing Mechanics:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Instant Bite:[/b] Fish bite immediately after casting.[/*]
[*][b]Instant Catch:[/b] Skip the fishing minigame entirely. Automatically reels in the fish .[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][b]Maximized Efficiency:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Max Cast:[/b] Automatically throws your line at maximum.[/*]
[*][b]Max Bobber Bar:[/b] Maximizes the size of your fishing bar for incredibly easy manual catches.[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][b]Loot & Catch Control:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Always Treasure:[/b] Forces a treasure chest to appear on every single catch.[/*]
[*][b]Anti-Trash (Always Catch Fish):[/b] Tired of Joja CDs and Broken Glasses? This feature automatically re-rolls your catch if it detects trash, guaranteeing a fish.[/*]
[*][b]Smart Algae, Seaweed & Jelly Logic:[/b] You have full control! Choose whether to keep Algae, Seaweed, and Jellies (Cave/River/Sea), or treat them as trash to be filtered out.[/*]
[*][b]Targeted "Fish Sniper":[/b] Looking for something specific? Input a fish ID to exclusively target and catch that exact fish.[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][b]Custom Fish Quality:[/b] Force all your caught fish to be a specific quality (Normal, Silver, Gold, or Iridium). The mod is built safely so it won't accidentally override the quality of items in your chests or shops.[/*]
[/list]⚙️ How to Use
[list=1]
[*]Install [b]SMAPI[/b].[/*]
[*]Extract the EasyFish folder into your Stardew Valley
[code]Mods[/code]folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game and press [b]J[/b] to open the mod menu and configure your settings![/*]
[/list]🛠️ Compatibility
[list]
[*]Fully compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6+.
[/*]
[/list]

Downloads.Description:
Fixed a bug that caused a crash when targeting journals and secret notes.

Since secret records and journals are not items that can be easily replaced, I designed the system in such a way that any attempt to target one of them would fail.
